propositions: dependabot PRs #123 and #124 are opened on GitHub (a read-only mirror) and cannot merge there; their diffs must be re-landed as Gerrit changes and the PRs closed by hand
PR #123 updates github-actions (setup-python v6→v7, pypi-publish re-pin) across 13 workflow files with new pinned SHAs and allowlist echo lines
PR #124 upgrades mcp from 1.29.0 to 2.0.0 (major version, breaking) and ruff from 0.15.22 to 0.16.1, with mcp constraint loosened from <2 to <3

mcp 2.0 removes v1 API paths that rebar-mcp imports (FastMCP, auth.settings/auth.provider, transport_security, ToolAnnotations), requiring test-driven verification of compatibility shims or deferral of the major upgrade
a P0 security vulnerability (PYSEC-2026-2132, command injection in click 8.2.1) blocks all CI until click is bumped to ≥8.3.3 in uv.lock, requiring an unblocking Change 0 that lands first
two out-of-pyproject.toml constraint consumers must be kept coherent with the mcp version decision: .github/workflows/_optionality.yml:105 and docs/adr/0050-mcp-optional-auth-resource-server.md:28
